cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import time,subprocess,sys
for name in ['big_stream','big_burst']:
    data=open(name+'.json','rb').read()
    t=time.time()
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/app/submission/scheduler.py'],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    dt=time.time()-t
    print(name,'rc',r.returncode,'time',round(dt,2),'outbytes',len(r.stdout),'err',r.stderr[:200])
